sources.entry: Kresus - Personal finance manager. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Nodejs/Docker

summary.one_liner: Kresus is an open-source, self-hosted personal finance manager for tracking bank transactions, checking balances, and tagging spending.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Kresus as a libre, self-hosted personal finance manager for tracking banking history and checking overall balance. It lets you tag transactions so you can see what you spend money on. The README says it began as a fork of cozy-pfm but has diverged significantly. Installation details are not in the README; it points to the kresus.org website for up-to-date instructions. The README does not describe the specific bank connection methods, interface, or data storage.
use_cases: replace a cloud finance app with a self-hosted one
how_to_run: See the kresus.org website for installation instructions (the README defers to it)
notable: Fork of cozy-pfm, now substantially different
Has a demo and source code listed in awesome-selfhosted
caveats: Installation is delegated to an external website; the README gives no commands
README does not state supported banks, platforms, or data storage details
Licensed under AGPL-3.0, which may matter for modified network deployments
